title: Three Evenings and One Short Hand
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·良好的人际关系与人际交往）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·良好的人际关系与人际交往）　|　核心词汇：gesture　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gesture 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the guide ① made a gesture that no stranger in the square would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the evening. The ② gesture, meaning the movement itself and not the word, ran three evenings and stayed undescribed in the book; a gesture, he said, is the only thing in a square that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ gesture in that square had the same short hand beside it, and the ④ gesture at the far arch, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A gesture, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the guide said the describing is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gesture was the whole of the matter, meaning the kindness and not the movement. The ⑥ gesture, meaning the kindness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gesture, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a movement and a kindness. He said the kindness is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ gesture had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short hand. The ⑧ gesture of the whole thing, the guide wrote in November, was one square and three evenings of describing; gesture, he said, is either the one at the far arch or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gesture I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the square. A ⑩ gesture, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being described; every gesture, she said, is a kindness that has agreed to look like a movement. She said the kindness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 手势；示意动作（指广场上每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 手势；示意动作（指那个动作本身，与话语相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a gesture 做一个手势
D. n. 手势（指留给孩子们学的那一个）
E. n. 表示；姿态（抽象总称，指一处广场的示意之事）
F. n. 手势（指记录本里写到、被画下的那一个）
G. n. 姿态；善意的表示（a gesture of kindness，指一件事里人人都懂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心意（抽象总称，指人人都懂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made a gesture that no stranger in the square would have described
The gesture, meaning the movement itself and not the word
the gesture at the far arch
the gesture was the whole of the matter
the gesture had become a line in a plan
The gesture of the whole thing
A gesture, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: make a gesture 意为“做一个手势”，1967 年那位向导做了广场上没有一位陌生人肯描述的一个手势。
gesture 意为“手势、示意动作”，指那个动作本身而不是话语，它经过了三个傍晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
gesture 意为“手势、示意动作”，指广场上每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只矮矮的手。
gesture 意为“手势”，指最远那道拱门下留给孩子们学的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gesture 意为“姿态、善意的表示”，指一件事里人人都懂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份善意就是那件事的全部。
gesture 意为“心意”，指人人都懂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个手势，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gesture 意为“手势”，指记录本里写到、被画下的那一个，到 1972 年这一个成了方案里的一行。
gesture 意为“表示、姿态”，向导十一月写道，整件事的示意之事是一处广场和三个傍晚的描述。
gesture 意为“手势”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那一个，1974 年不再做了，至今仍被说成广场上最安静的一个。
gesture 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一个手势是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
